text:
Welcome to this hell hole.
I’m Rick, and I’ll be your technician - Lucky you.

Before you wander off and try not to die, you’ll need to head to the storage bay and fetch the materials for your Portal Pass Key.
Bring ’em back, and I’ll get it sorted.

Actually I am gonna tweak something on your module.
Now you will be transported back here whenever you crash into anything.  Its gonna be annoying but it will help you learn to control this dumpster they call a spaceship.
You can go now. And remember if you crash its gonna hurt, you, your module more and me the most because I am gonna have to go through this @#X!#$% process again.

You are still here?
I thought I will have to train another newbie.

Well since you are still here I can tell you, I was looking over your footage.
In the cave that is directly in front of the portal is a boulder at the end. 
I think we can blow it to bits.
Go buy some explosives and try it.

Have you found Fluorite?
If you bring me some and I can use it to make acid that will eat right through those f%@$@!g mushrooms.

What did you find??
It has some really specific structure. Anyway now that its scanned I can make more if you need any by chance.

I forgot to tell ya. In the bottom left of you panel you have a line. That's timer, it tells you when the day ends. When it runs out you will be evacuated back here. And you are the one paying for that, I think its 5 or something.
Now go inside and get prepared for the next day.
You still haven't blown up that boulder. Just throw the explosives at it.
Some of the boulders here have mushroom growing through and through. I bet they will crumble the second you break those mushrooms.
Every geyser seems to be fed from some reservoir, and each opened geyser reduces pressure.
There seems to be opening at the back bottom part of the cave. Just throw some acid at the mushrooms in the way.
The dark spots on the walls seem to be from a material that absorbs energy. It may release it back if its overcharged.
